# sekejap-capi

The C ABI of [sekejap](https://github.com/sekejapdb/sekejap): one `extern "C"`
surface over the `sekejap` crate, built as a C dynamic library and a static
library named `libsekejap`.

The header `include/sekejap.h` is generated by cbindgen at build time. Every
language binding sekejap ships (C#, Dart, Go, Kotlin, Lua, Node, Python, Swift)
calls this surface and nothing else.

```sh
make            # build the library and regenerate the header
make check      # compile and run examples/smoke.c against it
make install    # library, header and sekejap.pc under PREFIX
```

The functions, their ownership rules and their error codes are described in
`docs/dist/C_ABI.md` in the repository.
